title: Copositive and completely positive cones over symmetric cones of rank at least 5
summary: We study copositive and completely positive cones over symmetric cones of rank at least $5$, with particular emphasis on whether these cones are spectrahedral shadows and on the behavior of a sum-of-squares inner-approximation hierarchy. We examine to what extent known results for nonnegative orthants of dimension at least $5$ carry over to general symmetric cones of rank at least $5$. We first prove that neither the copositive nor the completely positive cone over such a symmetric cone is a spectrahedral shadow.
